newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet before weekend.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks quiet before weekend.

text.p: Stocks were quiet in the after-hours session, especially on the eve of the weekend, dealers said on Friday.
"Its been relatively quiet," said one of them. "There's not much going on.
"It looks like everyone has gone for the weekend," he added.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 97,900 shares, compared with the previous day's 2,300, while session two had 3.6 million against 2.1 million.
